cds.title: Jacksonville State University Common Data Set 2025-2026 (PDF)

navigator.title: IPEDS / College Navigator - Jacksonville State University (campus setting: Suburb: Small)

stats.notes: CDS C1 (fall 2025): 3,951 men + 7,322 women applied, 2,858 + 5,398 were admitted, 1,641 enrolled (full- and part-time). The CDS leaves the in-state / out-of-state / international split of applicants and admits blank, so international applicant and admit counts are not available. No early decision or early action. Only 76 enrolled students submitted SAT scores (4.6%), so the SAT percentiles rest on a small group. Undergrad enrollment is the B1 total (9,028); intl_undergrads is the B2 nonresident total (231; IPEDS fall 2024 reports 373). The GPA distribution is as printed in C11 (30.2% at 4.0). Test-optional; the C7 importance checkboxes are not readable in the PDF, so no factors are recorded.

cds_test_policy.notes: CDS C8: test optional for admission; SAT/ACT can improve an admission decision. Students under a 3.0 cumulative GPA are admitted conditionally unless they have an 18+ ACT or equivalent SAT.
